```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 7.5,
  fig.height = 4.6,
  dpi = 120
)
library(rgraphtool)

load_or_fallback_lesmis <- function() {
  res <- tryCatch(netzschleuder_network("lesmis"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(res)) return(res)
  set.seed(42)
  n <- 48L
  b <- rep(1:4, each = 12L)
  el <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1L)) {
    for (j in (i + 1L):n) {
      if (stats::runif(1L) < ifelse(b[i] == b[j], 0.35, 0.025)) {
        el[[length(el) + 1L]] <- c(i, j)
      }
    }
  }
  list(graph = graph_add_edges(graph_create(n, directed = FALSE), do.call(rbind, el)))
}

load_or_fallback_celegans <- function() {
  res <- tryCatch(netzschleuder_network("celegansneural"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(res)) return(res)
  set.seed(42)
  n <- 80L
  b <- rep(1:4, each = 20L)
  el <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    for (j in seq_len(n)) {
      if (i == j) next
      p <- if (b[i] == b[j]) 0.14 else if (b[j] > b[i]) 0.12 else 0.01
      if (stats::runif(1L) < p) el[[length(el) + 1L]] <- c(i, j)
    }
  }
  list(graph = graph_add_edges(graph_create(n, directed = TRUE), do.call(rbind, el)))
}
```

This article combines the `assortative_sbm` and `ordered_sbm` demos, covering
two specialized microcanonical SBM priors: the **planted-partition SBM** for
assortative community detection (Zhang & Peixoto 2020) and the **ranked
(ordered) SBM** for discovering directed feed-forward hierarchies (Peixoto
2022).

## 1. Assortative community structure (planted-partition SBM)

The planted-partition model restricts block interactions to within-group vs.
between-group densities, yielding a sharper prior whenever community structure
is predominantly assortative. `compare_assortative_models()` tests non-uniform
and uniform planted-partition models directly against general flat and nested
SBMs.

```{r assortative-sbm, fig.height = 4.6}
lesmis <- load_or_fallback_lesmis()
g_lm <- lesmis$graph

set.seed(42)
pp_nu <- minimize_pp_blockmodel_dl(g_lm, uniform = FALSE)
pp_u  <- minimize_pp_blockmodel_dl(g_lm, uniform = TRUE)
print(pp_nu)
pp_assortativity(pp_nu)

set.seed(42)
cmp_pp <- compare_assortative_models(
  g_lm,
  models = c("pp", "pp_uniform", "sbm_flat", "sbm_nested"),
  method = "posterior",
  nsamples = 80L,
  thin = 5L,
  burnin = 40L
)
print(cmp_pp)

set.seed(42)
post_pp <- sample_posterior(pp_nu, nsamples = 80L, thin = 5L, burnin = 40L)
mode_pp <- partition_mode_state(post_pp$samples)

old_par <- graphics::par(mfrow = c(1L, 2L), mar = c(7, 4, 3, 1))
tab <- cmp_pp$summary
graphics::barplot(
  tab$delta,
  names.arg = tab$model,
  las = 2,
  ylab = "Delta(-log P(A)) [nats]",
  col = ifelse(tab$model == cmp_pp$best_model, "darkorange", "steelblue"),
  main = "Assortative vs. general SBM (0 = best)"
)
graphics::par(mar = c(2, 2, 3, 1))
plot_marginals(
  g_lm, mode_pp,
  main = sprintf("Planted-partition marginals (B = %d)", pp_nu$B)
)
graphics::par(old_par)
```

## 2. Ordered (ranked) communities in directed networks

For directed networks with directional flow (such as neural circuits, food
webs, or citation hierarchies), `ranked_block_state()` and
`nested_ranked_block_state()` jointly infer group memberships and a latent
rank ordering $u_r$ separating upstream ($u_i < u_j$), lateral ($u_i = u_j$),
and downstream ($u_i > u_j$) edges.

```{r ordered-sbm, fig.height = 4.8}
celegans <- load_or_fallback_celegans()
g_ce <- celegans$graph

set.seed(42)
cmp_ord <- compare_ordered_models(
  g_ce,
  models = c("unordered_flat", "unordered_nested",
             "ranked_flat", "ranked_nested"),
  method = "map",
  nruns = 2L
)
print(cmp_ord)

rk_nest <- cmp_ord$states$ranked_nested
ec <- ranked_edge_counts(rk_nest)
ec_tot <- ec$upstream + ec$lateral + ec$downstream
cat(sprintf(
  "Nested ranked SBM flow: %d upstream (%.1f%%), %d lateral (%.1f%%), %d downstream (%.1f%%)\n",
  ec$upstream, 100 * ec$upstream / ec_tot,
  ec$lateral, 100 * ec$lateral / ec_tot,
  ec$downstream, 100 * ec$downstream / ec_tot
))

old_par <- graphics::par(mfrow = c(1L, 2L), mar = c(8, 4, 3, 1))
tab_o <- cmp_ord$summary
graphics::barplot(
  tab_o$delta,
  names.arg = tab_o$model,
  las = 2,
  ylab = "Delta(DL) [nats]",
  col = ifelse(tab_o$model == cmp_ord$best_model, "darkorange", "steelblue"),
  main = "Unordered vs. ordered SBM (0 = best)"
)
graphics::par(mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))
plot_ranked_hierarchy(
  rk_nest,
  vertex_cex = 0.65,
  main = "C. elegans ordered community hierarchy"
)
graphics::par(old_par)
```
